cards.front: ¡No vuelvas a perder tu monedero!
cards.back: Don't lose your purse again!

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que ella va a perder su monedero.
cards.back: I'm sure she's going to lose her purse.

cards.front: No quiero volver a perder mi monedero.
cards.back: I don't want to lose my purse again.

cards.front: Es fácil perder tu abono en el Metro.
cards.back: It's easy to lose your travel card on the tube.

cards.front: Es bastante fácil perder tu abono en la estación de Metro.
cards.back: It's quite easy to lose your travel card in the tube.

cards.front: Es muy fácil perder tu abono si no tienes cuidado.
cards.back: It's very easy to lose your travel card if you're not careful.

cards.front: Es fácil perder cosas, como tu abono, en el Metro.
cards.back: It's easy to lose things, like your travel card, on the tube.

cards.front: Siempre estoy extraviando cosas, como por ejemplo mi monedero.
cards.back: I'm always losing things, like my purse.

cards.front: Asegúrate de no perder nada, como por ejemplo tu abono.
cards.back: Make sure you don't lose anything, like your travel card.

cards.front: Como yo, él a veces pierde cosas en el vagón del Metro.
cards.back: Like me, he sometimes loses things on the metro.

cards.front: Igual que su hermana, ella nunca pierde nada.
cards.back: Like her sister, she never loses anything.

cards.front: Ella pierde cosas a menudo, igualita que su madre.
cards.back: She often loses things, just like her mother.

cards.front: Mi mujer nunca pierde nada, no como yo.
cards.back: Unlike me, my wife never loses anything.

cards.front: A diferencia de su mujer, Donald a veces pierde cosas importantes, como por ejemplo su abono.
cards.back: Unlike his wife, Donald sometimes loses important things, like his travel card.

cards.front: A diferencia de su marido, Donna a veces pierde cosas importantes, como por ejemplo su monedero.
cards.back: Unlike her husband, Donna sometimes loses important things, such as her purse.

cards.front: Siempre pierdo al tenis.
cards.back: I always lose at tennis.

cards.front: No quiero perder la apuesta.
cards.back: I don't want to lose the bet.

cards.front: Creo que vamos a perder el partido.
cards.back: I think we're going to lose the match.

cards.front: Mi padre siempre pierde a las cartas. Da igual lo que haga.
cards.back: My father always loses at cards. It doesn't matter what he does.

cards.front: Mi hermano siempre pierde al tenis. Da igual cómo juegue.
cards.back: My brother always loses at tennis. It doesn't matter how he plays.

cards.front: Mi hermana siempre pierde las apuestas. Da igual lo que diga.
cards.back: My sister always loses bets. It doesn't matter what she says.

cards.front: Creo que vamos a perder contra ellos.
cards.back: I think we're going to lose against them.

cards.front: ¿Crees que el Manchester United va a perder contra el Liverpool?
cards.back: Do you think Manchester United is going to lose against Liverpool?

cards.front: Suelo perder contra mi hijo al tenis.
cards.back: I usually lose against my son at tennis.

cards.front: ¿Quién crees que va a ganar la guerra?
cards.back: Who do you think is going to win the war?

cards.front: Siempre ganan ellos. Da igual lo que hagamos.
cards.back: They always win. It doesn't matter what we do.

cards.front: Él nunca gana. Da igual lo que haga.
cards.back: He never wins. It doesn't matter what he does.

cards.front: Creo que nos van a ganar.
cards.back: I think they're going to beat us.

cards.front: ¿Crees que el Liverpool va a ganarle al Manchester United?
cards.back: Do you think Liverpool is going to beat Manchester United?

cards.front: Mi hijo me suele ganar al tenis.
cards.back: My son usually beats me at tennis.

cards.front: Ella quiere perder peso.
cards.back: She wants to lose weight.

cards.front: ¡No necesitas adelgazar!
cards.back: You don't need to lose weight!

cards.front: Necesito perder un poquito de peso.
cards.back: I need to lose a bit of weight.

cards.front: Pierdo la voz todos los inviernos.
cards.back: I lose my voice every winter.

cards.front: ¡Odio perder la voz!
cards.back: I hate losing my voice.

cards.front: Él nunca pierde la voz.
cards.back: He never loses his voice.

cards.front: Casi nunca pierdo los estribos.
cards.back: I hardly ever lose my temper.

cards.front: Él está siempre perdiendo los estribos.
cards.back: He's always losing his temper.

cards.front: ¡Tranquilo! ¡No pierdas los estribos!
cards.back: Calm down! Don't lose your temper!

cards.front: ¡Ten cuidado! Tienes mucho que perder.
cards.back: Be careful! You have a lot to lose.

cards.front: No importa. No tengo mucho que perder.
cards.back: It doesn't matter. I don't have a lot to lose.

cards.front: Trabajamos duro, pero tenemos mucho que perder.
cards.back: We work very hard, but we have a lot to lose.

cards.front: No tengo absolutamente nada que perder.
cards.back: I have absolutely nothing to lose.

cards.front: No le queda nada por perder.
cards.back: He has nothing left to lose.

cards.front: Van a hacerlo lo mejor que puedan; no tienen nada que perder.
cards.back: They're going to do their best; they have nothing to lose.

cards.front: Si no eres rápido, perderás el autobús.
cards.back: If you're not quick, you'll miss the bus.

cards.front: Si no te das prisa, perderás el autobús.
cards.back: If you don't hurry up, you'll miss the bus.

cards.front: Si no te apuras, perderás el autobús.
cards.back: If you don't get a move on, you'll miss the bus.

cards.front: Si te vas temprano, no perderás el tren.
cards.back: If you leave early, you won't miss the train.

cards.front: Si coges ese atajo, no perderás el tren.
cards.back: If you take that shortcut, you won't miss the train.

cards.front: Si te compras el billete por Internet, no perderás el tren.
cards.back: If you buy your ticket on the Internet, you won't miss the train.

cards.front: Él se perderá la boda si no se viste ahora mismo.
cards.back: He'll miss the wedding if he doesn't get dressed right now!

cards.front: Él se perderá la boda si no se levanta.
cards.back: He'll miss the wedding if he doesn't get up!

cards.front: Él se perderá la boda si se queda en la cama.
cards.back: He'll miss the wedding if he stays in bed!

cards.front: Se perderá la reunión si no la llevo en coche al trabajo.
cards.back: She'll miss the meeting if I don't drive her to work.

cards.front: Si ella se pierde la reunión, perderá el trabajo.
cards.back: If she misses the meeting, she'll lose her job.

cards.front: Si ella pierde su trabajo, se perderá todas las demás reuniones.
cards.back: If she loses her job, she'll miss all the other meetings.

cards.front: Nos perderemos la película si perdemos el autobús.
cards.back: We'll miss the film if we miss the bus.

cards.front: Se perderán el programa si llego tarde.
cards.back: They'll miss the programme if I'm late.

cards.front: Si te pierdes el partido, más tarde lo sentirás.
cards.back: If you miss the match, you'll be sorry later.

cards.front: Te echo de menos.
cards.back: I miss you.

cards.front: Te echo tanto de menos...
cards.back: I miss you so much.

cards.front: Te echo mucho de menos, ¿sabes?
cards.back: I really miss you, you know.

cards.front: A Camilla le gusta vivir en Suecia, pero echa de menos el estilo de vida español.
cards.back: Camilla likes living in Sweden, but she misses the Spanish lifestyle.

cards.front: Lo que más echa de menos él es la comida.
cards.back: What he misses the most is the food.

cards.front: Creo que mi perro me echa de menos cuando no estoy.
cards.back: I think my dog misses me when I'm away.

cards.front: Te echaré de menos cuando estés en el extranjero.
cards.back: I'll miss you when you're abroad.

cards.front: Te echaré de menos cuando te vayas de vacaciones.
cards.back: I'll miss you when you go on holiday.

cards.front: Te echaré mucho de menos cuando esté dormida.
cards.back: I'll really miss you when I'm asleep.

cards.front: Él me echará de menos cuando se mude a Alemania.
cards.back: He'll miss me when he moves to Germany.

cards.front: ¿Nos echará ella de menos cuando se mude a Brasil?
cards.back: Will she miss us when she moves to Brazil?

cards.front: Su hija le echará de menos cuando se mude a Londres.
cards.back: His daughter will miss him when she moves to London.

cards.front: Les echaremos de menos cuando dimitan.
cards.back: We'll miss them when they quit.

cards.front: ¿Quién me echará de menos cuando dimita?
cards.back: Who'll miss me when I resign?

cards.front: Todo el mundo le echará de menos a ella cuando dimita.
cards.back: Everyone will miss her when she quits.

cards.front: Echo de menos encargarme del jardín cuando estoy de vacaciones.
cards.back: I miss doing the gardening when I'm on holiday.

cards.front: Ella echa de menos bailar el twist.
cards.back: She misses doing the twist.

cards.front: Echo de menos hacer kárate. Espero que se me cure pronto la pierna.
cards.back: I miss doing karate. I hope my leg gets better.

cards.front: Echo de menos estudiar porque trabajar es mucho más mundano.
cards.back: I miss studying because working is more mundane.

cards.front: Él echa de menos estudiar porque disfruta aprendiendo.
cards.back: He misses studying because he enjoys learning.

cards.front: Esther echa de menos estudiar porque le gusta trabajar a su propio ritmo.
cards.back: Esther misses studying because she likes to work at her own pace.

cards.front: Echo de menos bailar hasta el amanecer.
cards.back: I miss dancing until dawn.

cards.front: Ella echa de menos bailar cuando está estudiando para sus exámenes.
cards.back: She misses dancing when she's studying for her exams.

cards.front: Ella echa de menos bailar cuando está trabajando.
cards.back: She misses dancing when she's working.

cards.front: No echaré de menos la nieve cuando deje de nevar.
cards.back: I won't miss it when it stops snowing.

cards.front: ¡No echaré de menos planchar cuando no tenga que hacerlo la semana que viene!
cards.back: I won't miss it when I don't have to do the ironing next week!

cards.front: Helen no echará de menos estudiar cuando ya no tenga que hacerlo.
cards.back: Helen won't miss it when she no longer has to study.

cards.front: Echaré de menos bailar juntos cuando seamos demasiado mayores para hacerlo.
cards.back: I'll miss it when we are too old to dance together.

cards.front: Echaremos de menos estudiar cuando ya no tengamos que hacerlo.
cards.back: We'll miss it when we don't have to study any more.

cards.front: Echarán de menos encargarse de la jardinería cuando se muden a la ciudad.
cards.back: They'll miss doing the gardening when they move to the city.
